visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a tight close-up of a whole, glistening roasted duck. A person wearing black latex gloves uses a sharp knife to slice into the crispy, amber-colored skin. The setting appears to be a professional kitchen or a high-end restaurant dining area with soft indoor lighting. (2) A male chef, dressed in a white uniform, tall white hat, and a green apron over a red shirt, carries a large platter with a roasted duck towards a table. He places it on a folding serving stand next to a table with plates and condiments. (3) Close-ups return, showing the chef's hands in black gloves expertly slicing thin pieces of duck skin and meat. The duck meat is a tender pink, contrasting with the dark, glossy skin. (4) The scene shifts to food presentation. A spoon scoops up creamy white congee containing shredded meat and red wolfberries. (5) Hands arrange sliced duck, slivers of green onion, and cucumber on a wooden tray with a small dish of dark brown sauce. (6) A piece of duck meat and skin is placed on a thin, translucent white pancake held by a hand. A spoon drizzles dark sauce over it before the pancake is rolled up. (7) Multiple dishes are showcased in rapid succession: stir-fried duck pieces with scallions and ginger in a metal pot, a large pot of congee being stirred, a bowl of taro and duck congee, a dish of tofu in a thick golden-yellow sauce, a salad with beef slices and garlic chips, and a soup with meat and red dates. (8) Dim sum items are presented: flaky pastries being broken open to reveal a red filling, and a black-and-white bun being torn apart to show a flowing yellow custard. (9) A person's hand flips through a professional menu with photos of dishes. The video ends with shots of the restaurant interior, featuring a private dining room with a large round table and a circular entrance, followed by booth seating and the restaurant's entrance signage in a mall setting.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Hook (Visual) -> Detailed Product Showcase (The Duck) -> List of Secondary Dishes -> Venue Showcase -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for 'Duck House Street' (鴨寮街) restaurant in Kaohsiung. It highlights their signature roasted duck, demonstrating the chef's slicing technique and various ways the duck is served (pancakes, stir-fry, congee). It also showcases a variety of other high-quality Cantonese dishes and dim sum to appeal to food lovers, ultimately encouraging viewers to visit and book a table.
